subject: pol-dym
title: POL.DYM.------WO.EXP.PRI.
description: Diagram opening R(AS)CM(II)-9 — the section on cultural-information focus as the structural ground beneath the present reality of creative music. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'It is important that this idea is challenged — because the present situation we are now living in has not simply come from nowhere.' The crossing diagrams how political-dynamics structurally meets world-expansion-principle to produce the present-situation the prose names: (C)POL-DYM (the concept of political dynamics) crossed with WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle). POL-DYM sits on the left with the subject-arrow; LG-EXT (logical extension) sits at the left and STF (source transfer) anchors the left-margin as the subject-side leftward output. TRS (transition) sits centrally and ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism) at the upper-right with SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics) on the right margin as the partner-side upper chain. SPT-DYM (spectacle dynamics) sits at the bottom-center as the bridging hub; PRI-INFO (principle information) anchors the bottom-left and WO-EXP-PRI is the partner-axis at lower-right. Structural argument: when political-dynamics is crossed with world-expansion-principle, the upper diagonal TRS → ACC-FT → SOC-RT-DY is the *cultural-information-focus route* — transition routes through accelerated-functionalism into social-reality-dynamics on the partner-side. This is the route that supplies the present-situation: political-dynamics's transformation reaches social-reality-dynamics by way of accelerated-functionalism that the receiving culture has built up over time. The leftward LG-EXT → STF output is what political-dynamics produces on its own — logical-extension into source-transfer, the form's own working chain. SPT-DYM at the bridging-bottom is the load-bearing hub: spectacle-dynamics routes PRI-INFO ← SPT-DYM → WO-EXP-PRI, supplying principle-information on the subject-bottom-left and the world-expansion-principle on the partner-bottom-right. The 'present situation' the prose names is exactly this configuration: political-dynamics's spectacle-dynamics hub converts principle-information into world-expansion-principle without ever crossing the upper diagonal's transformation route, leaving the subject's working chain on its own.
